name: DISA STIG — Juniper JunOS
description: Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guide for Juniper JunOS devices.

rules.name: Root authentication required
rules.description: Root authentication must be configured with an encrypted password

rules.name: No plaintext passwords
rules.description: Plaintext passwords must not appear in the configuration

rules.name: SSH service enabled
rules.description: SSH must be configured as the management access protocol

rules.name: No telnet service
rules.description: Telnet service must be disabled — cleartext management protocol

rules.name: System logging configured
rules.description: System logging (syslog) must be configured to a remote host

rules.name: NTP configured
rules.description: NTP must be configured for accurate time synchronization

rules.name: Login message configured
rules.description: A login message/banner must be configured for legal notice

rules.name: SNMP community not default
rules.description: Default SNMP community strings must not be used

rules.name: Firewall filter on loopback
rules.description: A firewall filter should protect the routing engine (lo0 interface)

rules.name: TACACS+ or RADIUS configured
rules.description: Centralized authentication via TACACS+ or RADIUS must be configured
